prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original fine-art cover illustration for a piano practice app's Library, not an album mockup. Create an edge-to-edge landscape 3:2 painting, ideally 1536×1024. Scene: an empty train-platform bench in soft rain, a single forgotten scarf draped naturally across the bench, and warm lights of a train receding into the distance. Narrative feeling: bittersweet departure and absence, intimate and restrained. There are no people. Medium: sophisticated editorial gouache, tactile matte pigment, visible fine paper grain and confident layered brushwork; richly painted atmospheric depth, elegant silhouette and deliberately simplified detail that remains legible at thumbnail scale. Subdued slate, soft dusty rose and muted neutral tones, with a small warm amber note from the distant train lights. Composition: bench and scarf are the quiet focal point, rain reflections lead toward the retreating train. Keep all important subjects inside the central 70% of the canvas; the full painting must work in 3:2 and with slight top/bottom cropping to 16:10. No border, no frame, no text, no readable station signs, no lettering, no logos, no watermark, no musical notation, no interface. No piano or instrument. Original artistic interpretation of an emotional theme, no famous artwork imitation.
qualityReview: Passed: expressive empty bench and forgotten scarf, rain atmosphere and receding warm train. Clear layered composition. No visible text, signs, logos or watermarks.
